units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 48:22">Targ. Gen. XLVIII, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:3:5">Y. Yeb. VII, 8ᵇ</cite> top <he>נסבה ח׳ וכ׳</he> she is entitled to a share with her sisters.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 142b:9">B. Bath. 142ᵇ</cite> <he>אית ח׳ לטליא או וכ׳</he> is the young man (to whom a share equal to that of the eventual future issue from a second wife was promised as a donation) entitled to that share besides the inheritance with the other children, or not?—Pl. <he>חוּלָּקִין</he>, <he>חוּלָּקַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 48:21">Targ. Ez. XLVIII, 21</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>חֻלְקַיָּא</he>); a. e. V. <cite ref="H01117"><he>חֶלְקָא</he></cite>.
